criteria.statement: A test shows per-rule output has rank, selected-in-search, skipped-for-curated-topic, and available-to-answer, including a parent/lettered-subrule case (514.3 present, 514.3a absent)
A test shows case-level per-rule coverage, complete-procedure coverage and `goldRuleInPrompt` are reported side by side
A test shows the trace refuses a dirty checkout and records its commit in `trace.json`
A test shows the compare command reports both commits, prompt-hash equality, coverage differences and one-sided cases from two fixture trace folders
`npm run eval:evidence-trace` runs over all approved cases on this checkout offline and its hit/miss agrees with `rules-gate/baseline.json` for every case, or lists each divergence by case id
`eval:evidence-trace` and `eval:evidence-trace:compare` exist in package.json and make no network call (test asserts no fetch)
